title: Aerial View of August Complex Fire Burn Scar near Hells Gate Campground
description: An aerial view shows the August Complex Fire burn scar near Hells Gate Campground in the Shasta-Trinity National Forest, California, March 6, 2026. Documenting the landscape following the 2020 wildfire assists the Forest Service in monitoring long-term forest recovery, soil stability, and the ongoing impacts of high-severity fire on the ecosystem. (Forest Service video by Andrew Avitt and Bob Doucette)
